name: vllm-rocm-r9700-main-wheel
description: vLLM v0.22.0 wheel compiled from OFFICIAL upstream source (vllm-project/vllm) for the AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 (gfx1201, RDNA4), on the TheRock gfx1201 torch 2.10/rocm7.13 base (no official rocm/vllm gfx1201 base exists). FROM-scratch wheel artifact; incremental via a persistent ccache mount (id=vllm-r9700-ccache, shared with the legacy in-place build). Consumed by the vllm-rocm-r9700-main assembler. Rebuild only when bumping VLLM_TAG or the TheRock base. ROCm is the _rocm_sdk_devel pip package (ROCM_PATH/HIP_PATH point there); the build needs the rust toolchain for vLLM's Rust extension. Build host 9700x8 (32-core EPYC).
